constraints.name: catalog_assets_description_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM description)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM description)) <= 2000)))

constraints.name: catalog_assets_public_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM public_name)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM public_name)) <= 120)))

tables.name: conversation_states
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_conversation_states_active_chatwoot_conversation_id ON public.conversation_states USING btree (chatwoot_conversation_id) WHERE (chatwoot_conversation_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_conversation_states_chatwoot_conversation_id ON public.conversation_states USING btree (chatwoot_conversation_id) WHERE (chatwoot_conversation_id IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: crm_media_assets
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_crm_media_conversation ON public.crm_media_assets USING btree (business_id, phone_number, created_at)

constraints.name: crm_media_assets_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (size_bytes > 0))))

tables.name: crm_send_attempts
indexes: CREATE INDEX crm_send_attempt_inflight ON public.crm_send_attempts USING btree (business_id, phone_number, kind, status)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crm_send_attempt_provider_id ON public.crm_send_attempts USING btree (business_id, provider_message_id) WHERE ((provider_message_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_message_id <> ''::text))

constraints.name: dashboard_admins_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: handoff_deliveries
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_handoff_deliveries_pending ON public.handoff_deliveries USING btree (business_id, status, retry_at)

tables.name: message_logs
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_message_logs_phone_created_at ON public.message_logs USING btree (phone_number, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_message_logs_event_key ON public.message_logs USING btree (event_key)

constraints.name: message_logs_role_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['user'::character varying, 'model'::character varying, 'system'::character varying, 'asesor'::character varying])::text[])))
